evidence: Kew/POWO accepts Campsis radicans and lists Texas within its native range.
USDA PLANTS-derived county data records C. radicans as native in Bell, San Saba, Travis, and Sutton Counties, all inside the current project target zone.
The project Hays County source list also includes C. radicans, but Hays is not needed to meet the threshold because the USDA-derived county layer already provides three firm target counties.
UT Plant Resources Center independently documents the species in Travis County and the Williamson County flora.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Trumpet creeper is widely planted and can escape cultivation, so ornamental observations should not be used to manufacture new native counties. The PASS rests on counties explicitly marked native in the USDA-derived layer.

morphology.look_here_first: Look at how the vine climbs and then count leaflets: trumpet creeper clings with aerial rootlets and has large odd-pinnate leaves with many sharply serrated leaflets.
diagnostic_traits: climbs by short aerial rootlets produced along stems rather than by tendrils
leaves opposite, odd-pinnately compound, commonly 7–11 leaflets
leaflets ovate to lanceolate with conspicuous serrate margins and pointed tips
large orange to reddish-orange tubular/funnelform flowers in terminal clusters
four fertile didynamous stamens plus a staminode, fitting the family pattern
fruit a long narrow 2-valved capsule containing numerous flattened winged seeds
extraloral nectary pits occur near the petiole/leaf axil in the detailed Williamson County treatment

confusers.separator: Crossvine climbs by branched tendrils with adhesive pads and usually has only two leaflets per leaf; trumpet creeper has many leaflets and aerial rootlets.
Coral honeysuckle has simple entire opposite leaves and berries, not pinnate leaves and a long dry capsule.
Catclaw vine has paired leaflets plus a claw-like tendril and is non-native; trumpet creeper has many serrated leaflets and rootlet climbing.

diagnostic_roles: mature split capsule with winged seeds

installation_guardrail: Do not install until Calvin explicitly approves B015 pass taxa.
